name: Secret Tunnel
clause: {4}, {T}: Two target creatures you control that share a creature type can't be blocked this turn.

needs.proposedSignature: Filter.sharesCreatureTypeWith?: Ref | 'chosen'  plus TargetSpec.sharedTypeGroup?: true (several picks of one requirement must agree)
needs.semantics: Target legality and mass-sacrifice filters that compare creature types between two objects — 'two target creatures you control that share a creature type', 'creatures that don't share a creature type with the chosen creature'. Checked both when targets are offered (legal.ts) and when they are re-checked on resolution.
needs.clause: Two target creatures you control that share a creature type can't be blocked this turn.
